blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Special Prosecutor (OSP) has asked the Sandiganbayan Third Division to exclude Felicito Guevarra, the co-accused of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, from the P7.4-billion plunder case following his surrender last week. Last Friday, the Ombudsman announced that Guevarra surrendered Thursday to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) after his passport was canceled. Prosecutors sought to amend the Information to exclude Guevarra from the P7.4-billion plunder case. The Ombudsman earlier said that Samchan already restituted all its earnings to the Bureau of Treasury from the “questioned transactions.” The OSP is a component office of the […]...
